description: Source code defining the IncomingWebhook model, request handling, validation, and utility functions for Mattermost webhooks.

classes.name: IncomingWebhook
classes.description: Represents an incoming webhook with metadata such as IDs, display info, and lock status.

classes.name: IncomingWebhookRequest
classes.description: Represents a request payload for incoming webhooks, including message content and properties.

classes.name: IncomingWebhooksWithCount
classes.description: Container for a list of incoming webhooks with total count.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of webhook fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the webhook's fields, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the webhook object before saving, assigning ID and timestamps.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates the timestamp before modifying the webhook.

methods.name: escapeControlCharsFromPayload
methods.description:
Escapes control characters (
, 	) in specific JSON string fields within a payload.

methods.name: decodeIncomingWebhookRequest
methods.description: Decodes JSON bytes into an IncomingWebhookRequest object.

methods.name: IncomingWebhookRequestFromJSON
methods.description: Reads JSON data and returns a decoded IncomingWebhookRequest, attempting to escape invalid control characters if needed.
